summary: Richmond County tower named only on the tnlandforms list, tagged topo rather than with a commission number; no source found describes the site.

evidence.supports: Steadman row: Richmond County, coordinates 33.390412, -82.106239 (six decimal places), elevation 439, source tag topo
The Statenville and Staunton rows use five decimal places for coordinates
Notes: entries come from the USGS name database and towers discovered on 1:100,000 USGS topo maps and NGS data sheets

notes_for_editor: Thinnest record of the three: one source (the tnlandforms list) names Steadman. The cached NHLR Georgia pages, the cached FFLOS Georgia pages and the Commons Georgia Forestry Commission tower category (29 files) do not name it. Search results showed a Steadman Cemetery in Richmond County; it is not used because nothing ties it to the tower. No photo, history, staffing or status was found. The 'topo' tag is the list's own label, and the reading that the point may be a map position is an inference from the list's notes, flagged as such in the story. Brief status and access are unknown and remain so. Confidence is low and the story is short because the sources are.
